# telnyx_porting_order_phone_number_blocks (Data Source)

Lists porting order phone number blocks, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_porting_order_phone_number_block`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `porting_order_id` (String) The porting order id.

### Optional

- `filter_activation_status` (String) Activation status One of `Activate RDY`, `Active`, `Cancel Pending`, `Cancelled`, `Concurred`, `Concurrence Sent`, `Conflict`, `Disconnect Pending`, `Failed`, `New`, `Old`, `Pending`, `Sending`.
- `filter_phone_number` (List of String) Filter results by a list of phone numbers
- `filter_portability_status` (String) Specifies whether Telnyx is able to confirm portability this number in the United States & Canada. International phone numbers are provisional by default. One of `confirmed`, `pending`, `provisional`.
- `filter_porting_order_id` (List of String) Filter results by a list of porting order ids
- `filter_status` (String) Filter porting orders by status(es). Originally: filter[status], filter[status][in][]
- `filter_support_key` (String) Filter results by support key(s). Originally: filter[support_key][eq], filter[support_key][in][]
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort_value` (String) Specifies the sort order for results. If not given, results are sorted by created_at in descending order One of `-created_at`, `created_at`.

### Read-Only

- `porting_order_phone_number_blocks` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_order_phone_number_blocks))

<a id="nestedatt--porting_order_phone_number_blocks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `porting_order_phone_number_blocks`

Read-Only:

- `activation_ranges` (Attributes List) Specifies the activation ranges for this porting phone number block. The activation range must be within the phone number range and should not overlap with other activation ranges. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_order_phone_number_blocks--activation_ranges))
- `country_code` (String) Specifies the country code for this porting phone number block. It is a two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies this porting phone number block.
- `phone_number_range` (Attributes) Specifies the phone number range for this porting phone number block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_order_phone_number_blocks--phone_number_range))
- `phone_number_type` (String) Specifies the phone number type for this porting phone number block.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--porting_order_phone_number_blocks--activation_ranges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `porting_order_phone_number_blocks.activation_ranges`

Read-Only:

- `end_at` (String) Specifies the end of the activation range. It must be no more than the end of the phone number range.
- `start_at` (String) Specifies the start of the activation range. Must be greater or equal the start of the phone number range.


<a id="nestedatt--porting_order_phone_number_blocks--phone_number_range"></a>
### Nested Schema for `porting_order_phone_number_blocks.phone_number_range`

Read-Only:

- `end_at` (String) Specifies the end of the phone number range for this porting phone number block.
- `start_at` (String) Specifies the start of the phone number range for this porting phone number block.
